subject: Tiered early-pay program details + PO routing question
messages:
From: Jordan Kim <jordan.kim@lumoforge.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: accounts-payable@lumoforge.com, s.holden@lumoforge.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on payment lanes and PO routing

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the warm onboarding call last week. We're finalizing our vendor packet and had two quick items before we submit the signed PO:

1) Early-pay program: Our finance team asked whether Redwood offers a tiered early-pay schedule (e.g., 1% for net30 paid in 10 days / 0.5% for net45 paid in 20 days). If that exists, can you share the standard ladder or a worksheet so we can model the benefit?

2) PO routing and remittance: We need to confirm the exact PO number format and which email/portal the AP team should send invoices to so they flow into your dedicated PO lane. Right now they plan to send invoices to accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com but want to avoid routing delays.

Attaching our W-9 and our preferred contact for AP. If you prefer we can upload the PO into your vendor portal — tell me the URL and I'll route it.

Appreciate the help — Samantha (AP) is cc'd and may jump in.

Best,
Jordan Kim
Head of Finance Operations
LumoForge

Attachments: W-9_LumoForge.pdf
From: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: Jordan Kim <jordan.kim@lumoforge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on payment lanes and PO routing

Jordan — thanks for the clear note and for sending the W-9. Short answers below, plus next steps.

1) Early-pay tiers: Yes — we run a simple tiered early-pay program for strategic vendors. Typical structure: net60 default, opt-in to a 1% discount if paid within 10 days, 0.5% if paid within 20 days, and 0.25% if within 30 days. The program is evaluated per account and requires AP enrollment (so we can track it against the PO). I've attached the "Proposed_SLA_and_Payment_Ladder.xlsx" with the sample math.

2) PO routing: Use POs that begin with "RW-" followed by the deal id (e.g., RW-LF-3491). The canonical invoice endpoint is invoices@redwoodinference.com for portal-less submissions; invoices submitted there and including the RW- prefix route automatically into the PO lane. If you want to use our vendor portal instead, upload at https://vendors.redwoodinference.com and include the PO field — that gives the fastest processing.

Next steps:
- If you'd like to opt into the early-pay ladder, reply with a confirmation from your AP team and we will generate the enrollment ticket.
- If you prefer portal upload, send me the account email and I'll add them to the vendor ACL.

Cc'ing Kimberly (billing ops) and Grace (partner ops) so they can assist on enrollment and intake.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if it's helpful.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Proposed_SLA_and_Payment_Ladder.xlsx

Hi Mateo — thanks for the details and the sample ladder, that's exactly what we needed. LumoForge would like to opt into the following for this initial PO:

- Enrollment: yes, please enroll us in the early-pay program tied to RW-LF-3491.
- Preferred discount: 1% if paid within 10 days.
- Invoice submissions: we'll send invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com and include PO RW-LF-3491 in the header and PDF body.

We'll ask our billing team to upload the PO to your vendor portal as a backup. Can you confirm whether opting in to early-pay requires a separate ACH form or if it's handled purely on Redwood's side?

Thanks — Samantha
AP Manager, LumoForge

Samantha — welcome! I'll take point on the enrollment and the operational steps. Quick checklist: 

- Enrollment: I'll open the vendor enrollment ticket and attach the W-9 you provided. Once you confirm the desired discount (1% / 10 days), I'll toggle the early-pay flag against RW-LF-3491.
- ACH / Remit: We do not require a new ACH form just to enroll in early-pay. If you want payment via ACH to accelerate remittance, please fill out the standard vendor banking form (I'll attach to the ticket). Otherwise we can apply the discount and process on our standard payment runs.
- Portal access: If you upload the PO to vendors.redwoodinference.com, please use the same AP email (accounts-payable@lumoforge.com). That will create an automatic link between the PO and invoices.

I'll create the ticket now and share the enrollment link (DocuSign optional). Expect the ticket ID in the next hour.
